chapter.verse: Tua vantungmi sagihte kiangah, “Note pai un la, Pasian’ hehna hai sagihte leitungah bua un,” ci-in biakinnpi sung pan nakpi kiko aw ka za hi.
Khatna vantungmi pai-in, ama tawi hai leitungah a buak leh, sahang ciamtehna nei-in, ama milim a bia mite tungah kihhuai meima a piang hi.
Nihna vantungmi in ama tawi hai, tuipi tungah a buak leh, tuipi tui in misite’ sisan bang suak a, tuipi sungah a om ganhing khempeuh a si uh hi.
Thumna vantungmi in ama tawi hai, gunte leh cikte tungah a buak leh, tui in sisan suak a,
tui ngak vantungmi in, “Tu lai takin a om, a om ngei zo, Siangtho Topa aw, nangmah in hih bangin thu na khen ahih ciangin midik na hi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, amaute in misiangthote’ sisan leh kamsangte’ sisan a bua uh a, amaute sisan na dawnsak zo hi. Amaute zong a dawn dingun kilawm hi,” a cihna ka za hi.
Biakna tau in zong, “Ahi hi. Vanglianpen Topa Pasian aw, na thukhennate a man a dik uh hi,” a cih thu ka za hi.
Lina vantungmi in ama tawi hai ni tungah a buak leh, ni in mite mei a katsak nading thu a ngah hi.
Mei sa pha lua-in mite a kang tum uh a, gimnate a uk Pasian’ min a kosia uh hi. Topa’ vangliatna phat nading a kisik kei uh hi.
Ngana vantungmi in ama tawi hai sahang tokhom tungah a buak leh, sahang gam in khuamial suak a, a gamsung mite in na sa-in a leii uh a gawi uh hi.
Amau natna meimate hangin vantung Pasian a kosia uh hi. Amaute gamtatnate zong a kisik kei uh hi.
Gukna vantungmi in ama tawi hai Eufrates gunpi tungah a buak leh, ni suahna lam pan hong pai uh kumpite ading a baihsa a pian’ nadingin guntui a kang hi.
Tua lai takin gulpi kam, sahang’ kam, thuzuau hilhte’ kam uh sung pan uiphuk tawh kibang a kihhuai kha gilo pawl thum a pusuakkhia ka mu hi.
Amaute in nalamdangte lakin Vanglianpen Pasian’ ni lianpi-ah galdo-in leitung khempeuh pan kumpite kikhawmsak dingun a paikhia dawigilo’ khate ahi uh hi.
En in, keimah in guta hong pai bangin ka hong tung ding hi! Puan silh loin pai-in mi mai-ah zumna om loh nadingin ngakin, ama puante a keem mi in thupha a ngah ding hi.
Dawigilo khate in kumpite, Hebru kamin Armageddon a kici munah a kikhawmsak uh hi.
Sagihna vantungmi in ama tawi hai huih lakah a buak leh, “A zo zo hi!” ci-in biakinnpi sung tokhom pan nakpi-in aw kiko a,
khuaphialepte, awte, vangingte a piang uh hi. Mite in leitungah a om uh-a kipan cikmah huna piang ngei lo a lian a haksa mahmah zinlin’na a piang hi.
Khuapi in seh thumin a kikhen hi. Gam sungah a om khuapite zong a cim uh hi. Babilon khuapite zong Pasian’ hehna lianpi leenggahzu hai a dawnsak dingin Pasian mai-ah tua khuapi kiciamtehin a om hi.
Tuikulh gam khempeuh a mangthang hi. Mualte zong kimu lo hi.
Tua lai takin vantung pan tawi zali bang a gik gialpi kia a, mite in tua gialpi gimna hangin Pasian a kosia uh hi, bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua gimna in a lian mahmah hi.
